objectives: Apply the rules of the whole course to complete files, from the first call to the archive.
Find the legal problems in a file before the signing day.
Choose the correct form, notary, documents, checks and payment method for each deal.
Calculate the fees and taxes of a file and say who pays them.
Recognise the moments when the office must stop, refuse or ask the notary.

cards.front: A flat bought during the marriage in the husband's name. Who sells?
cards.back: **Both spouses**: common property ([[sk:21:1]]) is disposed of jointly ([[sk:24:3]]).

cards.front: The seller has public debts. What are the two ways to proceed?
cards.back: Pay them first, or the seller declares that they are paid from the price and the buyer pays them into the budget ([[dopk:264:4]]).

cards.front: What is the order of acts in a sale with two banks?
cards.back: Consent to delete the old mortgage, sale deed, new mortgage deed; all entered the same day, because the rank of a mortgage follows the entry ([[zzd:169]]).

cards.front: Can parents sign a gift deed at home?
cards.back: **No**: deeds for entry are issued only in the office in working hours ([[gpk:573:2]]). A power of attorney can be certified at home ([[gpk:573:3|Art. 573(3)]]).

cards.front: The notary certifies a power of attorney at the donors' home in the same town, in working hours. What is added to the fee?
cards.back: **+25%** for an act outside the office in working hours ([[tarifa:23|item 23]] letter "а" ТНТ); out of hours: 50% (letter "в").

cards.front: A 15-year-old heir sells her share. What is needed?
cards.back: She signs with a parent's **consent** ([[sk:129]]) and the **permission of the district court** of her current address ([[sk:130:3]]).

cards.front: A co-owner sells a share to a third person. What comes first?
cards.back: A written **offer** to the other co-owners and a declaration before the notary that nobody accepted ([[zs:33]]).

cards.front: A car insured for 8,000 € is sold for 8,500 €. What is the fee base?
cards.back: **8,500 €**: the contract price applies when it is higher than the insured value ([[znnd:97:1|Art. 97(1)]] and [[znnd:97:3|(3) ЗННД]]).

cards.front: Can the applicant's son be a witness in a circumstantial verification?
cards.back: **No**: relatives in the direct line are excluded ([[gpk:584::3|Art. 584 item 3]] and [[gpk:575]]).

cards.front: Is the fee for a circumstantial verification returned after a refusal?
cards.back: **No**: it is due when the request is filed and is not returned (note to [[tarifa:11|item 11 ТНТ]]; [[znnd:88:1]]).

cards.front: Who may take back a deposited holographic will?
cards.back: Only the **testator personally** ([[zn:26:1]]); the note of the return in the register is signed by the testator, two witnesses and the notary ([[zn:26:2|Art. 26(2)]]).

cards.front: An OOD has four partners with equal shares. Three vote to admit the buyer of a share. Is the buyer admitted?
cards.back: **No**: three of four is exactly three quarters; the decision needs **more than** three quarters of the capital ([[tz:137:3]]).

quiz.question: Case 1: the revenue agency check shows that the seller owes 320 € of public debts. Which option allows the deal on the same day?
options: The seller declares in writing; the buyer pays 320 € into the budget
The buyer pays the seller 320 € more in cash, for the debt
The notary ignores a debt below 500 € and notes it in the deed
The seller promises in the deed to pay the debt within one month
quiz.explanation: [[dopk:264:4]]: when the seller has public debts, the deed may be issued after they are paid, or when the seller declares in writing that they are paid from the price and the buyer pays the amount into the budget. A payment to the seller or a promise does not satisfy the law.

quiz.question: Case 1: why is the consent to delete the old mortgage entered before the new mortgage?
options: The buyer's bank wants the first rank; the rank follows the entry
The registry office enters one act per property each day
The law allows only one mortgage on a property at a time
The fee for the new mortgage is lower after a deletion
quiz.explanation: [[zzd:169]]: a mortgage has its rank from the entry. The deletion of the old mortgage is entered first, so that the new bank's mortgage takes the first rank; several mortgages on one property are possible, with different ranks.

quiz.question: Case 2: the elderly donors cannot travel. What can the office offer?
options: A power of attorney certified at their home, naming the gift
A gift deed signed at their home, before two witnesses
A gift deed signed by the son alone, as their representative
A gift deed signed at home and confirmed later in the office
quiz.explanation: [[gpk:573:2]]: deeds for entry are issued only in the office in working hours; [[gpk:573:3|Art. 573(3)]]: other acts may be performed outside the office for good reasons. The donors give a power of attorney with signature and content certified at home ([[zzd:37]]), naming the gift and the donee.

quiz.question: Case 2: is local tax due on a gift from parents to their son?
options: No; gifts in the direct line are exempt
Yes, 0.4–0.8%, as between relatives
Yes, 3.3–6.6%, as between other persons
Yes, up to 3%, as for a purchase
quiz.explanation: [[zmdt:44:6]]: gifts between relatives in the direct line and between spouses are exempt from the tax. The rate 0.4–0.8% applies between siblings and their children, 3.3–6.6% between other persons ([[zmdt:47:1|Art. 47(1)]]).

quiz.question: Case 3: a man brings a power to sell his flat, already signed at home. What must happen?
options: He writes his full name and confirms the signature before the notary
The clerk certifies the signature; the notary certifies the content
The notary certifies only the signature; the content stays uncertified
He signs a new power before a notary of Burgas, where the flat is
quiz.explanation: [[zzd:37]]: a power for a sale of real estate needs signature and content certified at the same time; [[gpk:589:2]]: for a document about rights in real estate the person writes the full name and confirms the signature before the notary. Any notary may certify it ([[gpk:570:2|Art. 570(2)]]).

quiz.question: Case 3: a caller wants a sale deed for his flat in Burgas from your Sofia office. What do you say?
options: Only a notary of the district of the flat issues the deed
Any notary in the country can issue the deed
A Sofia notary can, with a 50% additional fee
A Sofia notary can, after a decision of the Chamber
quiz.explanation: [[gpk:570:1]]: deeds for the transfer of real estate are issued by the notary in whose district the property is. The Sofia office can certify the power of attorney ([[gpk:570:2|Art. 570(2)]]) and send the client to a notary in Burgas.

quiz.question: Case 4: Todor inherited the plot and left a widow and two children. What are the shares?
options: One third each
The widow one half, the children one quarter each
The children one half each; the widow nothing
The widow everything; the children after her death
quiz.explanation: [[sk:22:1]]: property inherited during the marriage is personal, so the widow has no share as a spouse. [[zn:9:1]]: the spouse inherits a share equal to that of each child; [[zn:5:1|Art. 5(1)]]: the children inherit in equal shares: one third each.

quiz.question: Case 4: who gives permission for the sale of the 15-year-old heir's share?
options: The district court of her current address
Her mother alone, as her legal representative
The notary, in the deed of sale
The mayor of the municipality of her address
quiz.explanation: [[sk:130:3]]: a disposal of real estate of a child needs the permission of the district court of the child's current address. The mother's consent to the minor's signature ([[sk:129|Art. 129]]) is needed too, but it does not replace the court.

quiz.question: Case 5: the wife did not sign the sale of the common car. What is the risk?
options: She can challenge the sale, as for real estate
None; the car is the husband's personal property
The sale is void by law, without a claim
Only an administrative fine for the husband
quiz.explanation: [[sk:24:5]]: a disposal of a common movable that needs certified signatures follows [[sk:24:4|Art. 24(4)]]: the other spouse may challenge it in court within six months of learning of it, not later than three years. The sale is voidable, not void.

quiz.question: Case 5: what is the base of the local tax on the car?
options: The insured value
The agreed price
The higher of the two
The market price set by the notary
quiz.explanation: [[zmdt:46:2:2|Art. 46(2) item 2 ЗМДТ]] refers to [[zmdt:33:1|Art. 33(1)]], which values vehicles at their insured value, in euro. The base of the notarial fee is different: the price, when it is higher than the insured value ([[znnd:97:3]]).

quiz.question: Case 6: why is the handwritten contract of 2008 not enough?
options: A transfer of real estate needs a notarial deed
It is too old; a contract expires after ten years
It was not entered in the property register
It was not certified by a mayor or a notary
quiz.explanation: [[zzd:18]]: contracts for the transfer of ownership of real estate are made by a notarial deed; a written contract transfers nothing, so it could not be entered. Dimitar relies on possession for ten years ([[zs:79]]) and a circumstantial verification ([[gpk:587:2]]).

quiz.question: Case 7: a nephew brings a power of attorney to take back his aunt's deposited will. Answer?
options: Refuse; only the testator personally can take it back
Accept, with a power certified for signature and content
Accept, with two witnesses who sign the register
Accept, if the testator confirms by telephone
quiz.explanation: [[zn:26:1]]: a deposited holographic will may be taken back only by the testator personally; a power of attorney does not replace the personal act. The two witnesses of [[zn:26:2|Art. 26(2)]] sign the note of the return together with the testator.

quiz.question: Case 8: the company has unpaid April wages. Can the share pass to a new partner?
options: No, not while wages are due and unpaid
Yes, if the buyer takes over the wages in the contract
Yes, with the written consent of the employees
Yes, if the price covers the unpaid wages
quiz.explanation: [[tz:129:1]]: a transfer to a third person is possible only when there are no unpaid due wages, compensations and social contributions of the workers; the manager and the transferor declare this ([[tz:129:2|Art. 129(2)]]). A takeover or a consent does not change the ban.

quiz.question: Case 8: which fee applies to the share transfer contract?
options: An ordinary fee, as the content is certified with the signatures
Item 8 of the tariff, on the price of the share
Item 10 of the tariff, on the price of the share
Item 9 of the tariff, on the capital of the company
quiz.explanation: [[znnd:90:2]]: for the certification of the content of a document that the Commerce Act requires together with the signatures, an ordinary notarial fee is due. The proportional items 8, 9 and 10 do not apply to this contract.
